summary: Bragg Gaming Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K with its interim unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements and MD&A for the three-month period ended March 31, 2026. The filing includes routine quarterly financial results, a news release, and certifications by the CEO and CFO. No indication of any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, or other extraordinary corporate event is present. This is a standard periodic report filed by a foreign private issuer.
